name: N8N-Automation-Suite
headline: Cold Emailer - AI-Powered Cold Outreach Tool
short_description: Cold Emailer is an AI-driven tool that automates personalized cold outreach for job seekers and professionals. It generates tailored emails, logs interactions, and manages follow-ups seamlessly, enhancing productivity in outreach efforts.
author: harshmriduhash

sections.overview:
Cold Emailr is a full-stack AI agent that automates personalized cold email outreach using OpenAI to generate tailored messages matched to job descriptions and company values. The tool integrates with Google Drive to automatically attach your latest resume and logs every sent email in Google Sheets with follow-up dates set for three days later. Built with a Next.js frontend and n8n backend automation, it streamlines the entire outreach workflow from email generation through follow-up tracking. Job seekers and professionals benefit from reduced manual effort while maintaining personalization at scale, with all data tracked transparently in a centralized Google Sheet for accountability and measurement.
Automating cold email campaigns
Generating personalized outreach messages
Tracking email interactions in Google Sheets
Setting up follow-up reminders
sections.usage:
```
I'm a [JOB TITLE] looking for a [JOB TYPE] role in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Generate a personalized cold email to [RECIPIENT NAME] at [COMPANY]. Include my relevant skills: [SKILLS]. Keep it professional but engaging, and suggest a follow-up email if no response.
```
Copy

```
# Cold Email Draft

**Subject:** Exploring Opportunities in [INDUSTRY] at [COMPANY]

Hi [RECIPIENT NAME],

I hope this email finds you well. I came across [COMPANY]'s work in [INDUSTRY] and was particularly impressed by [SPECIFIC ACHIEVEMENT OR PROJECT]. As a [JOB TITLE] with experience in [SKILLS], I believe my background aligns well with the innovative work your team is doing.

I would love the opportunity to discuss how my skills in [SKILLS] could contribute to [COMPANY]'s goals. Would you be available for a brief call next week? I've attached my resume for your review.

Looking forward to your thoughts.

Best regards,
[YOUR NAME]

**Follow-up Email Suggestion:**

If no response within a week, send:

*Subject:* Following Up on Potential Collaboration

Hi [RECIPIENT NAME],

I wanted to follow up on my previous email regarding potential opportunities at [COMPANY]. I understand you're busy, but I believe my experience in [SKILLS] could be valuable to your team. Would you be open to a quick chat?

Best regards,
[YOUR NAME]
```
